Sales to Employees:       Pursuant to MS Code 25-4-105 (3) (b), school board members and district employees, as well as the spouses and dependent children of the school board members and the district employees of the Seller are *NOT ELIGIBLE TO BID* on the property listed for auction.
*️⃣*️⃣*️⃣ PLEASE NOTE ... DUE TO THE COST OF MATERIALS, THE FOLLOWING CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE:
✳️✳️ Currently stored loose on 1 pallet, additional charges will apply for boxes (see below).
⭐⭐ SEE ATTACHED PDF FILE FOR SERIAL #'S OF THE LAPTOPS IN THIS LOT
⭐ Buyer arranged shipping will be accepted (see below for materials/handling fees by Seller), but the Buyer will be responsible for selecting their own carrier, negotiate rates, shipping terms, and will remit payment directly to the carrier/shipper of their choice. At NO time will the Seller be liable for any shipping fees. Buyer will provide their own shipping insurance and will NOT hold the Seller liable for any damage incurred during shipping.
⭐ The Seller will shrink wrap the pallet and apply the prepaid label to the outside of the pallet/box. Every effort will be made to package the items in a safe and secure manner, but the Seller is NOT liable for damages incurred during shipping.
⭐ A 'Prepaid Label Shipping Waiver for Assets Won on GovDeals' MUST be completed and returned to the Seller prior to pick up. If this is not completed, the Seller will NOT release the items.
⭐ IF the Buyer arranges their own shipping, there will be a materials/handling FEE of $50.00 PER PALLETor LOT. Additional fees will be applied if boxes are requested ... $5.00 per box and $50.00 per Gaylord.
* Items must be removed within 10 days from auction end (or your account could be locked).
*** PLEASE NOTE ... NO CHARGING CORDS
* Most of these have 4GB Memory with 128 GB Hard Drive (but we did not check each one)
* ✳️✳️ These are DAMAGED laptops, broken in some way, MAY still WORK but were NOT TESTED
* We were told hard drives have all been WIPED, NOT REMOVED, but THESE WERE NOT CHECKED by Surplus Department.
* If you would like to inspect this lot prior to bidding, you MUST schedule an appointment to do so.
* This listed LOT is in UNKNOWN condition. This LOT may be missing parts and/or have some cosmetic damage. This LOT is sold AS IS, with NO GUARANTEES OR WARRANTIES. In regard to accessories, attachments, manuals, cords, etc., if it is NOT PICTURED, it is NOT INCLUDED in the sale of the item.
* Call 901-584-7664 or e-mail kay.shelton@dcsms.org for scheduling.

274431025.description: This lot includes a variety of collectible gemstones and minerals in both polished and raw forms. The assortment features tumbled stones, crystal points, a polished black agate slice with a gold edge, and a heart-shaped labradorite. Also included is a block of Genuine Wyoming Jade, a beaded stone bracelet, and a string of chip stones. The stones display a range of colors such as green, purple, black, yellow, brown, and clear/white, composed of minerals including jade, amethyst, agate, and others. All pieces are in good used condition with no obvious damage, suitable for collectors, crafters, or those interested in metaphysical properties.

274681529.description:
This lot includes five assorted mineral and gemstone specimens: a polished black stone (possibly obsidian), a yellow tumbled stone (potentially yellow jasper or calcite), a metallic cubic stone (likely pyrite), a brown and white rounded stone (possibly agate or jasper), and a desert rose gypsum specimen. Each stone is palm-sized and in good used condition with minimal wear. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or metaphysical applications.
